data.title: 烛光大厅的双人礼服整理
data.location: 暖烛摇曳的复古宴会休息厅
data.lighting: 水晶烛台暖金侧光与复古木墙暗影
data.camera: 双人平视半身中景横幅
data.prompt: 2girls, vintage banquet parlor, warm candelabra glow, velvet sofa, medium shot, (ayachi_nene, ayachi_nene_on_left, silver white hair, low twintails, purple eyes, ahoge, pink ribbons, pearl white chiffon off-shoulder evening gown, pink satin waist sash, holding small floral bouquet, shy radiant smile, looking at viewer) BREAK (shiki_natsume, shiki_natsume_on_right, long black hair, two red hairclips, golden eyes, mole under eye, champagne and black satin evening gown, leaning gently toward left, slender fingers straightening Nene's hair ornament, fond quiet smile)
data.animaCaption: Seated left in a pearl-white chiffon evening gown holding a small bouquet, Ayachi Nene smiles shyly toward you while Shiki Natsume on the right in champagne-and-black satin leans across to straighten Nene's hair ornament. Warm candelabra flames gild both dresses against the quiet vintage parlor.
data.promptProse: In a warm candlelit vintage parlor framed horizontally at medium distance, Ayachi Nene sits on the left wearing a pearl-white chiffon off-shoulder evening gown tied with a pink satin sash, her silver-white low twin tails and purple eyes brightening as she cradles a small bouquet and smiles shyly toward the viewer. Beside her on the right, Shiki Natsume wears a sleek champagne-and-black satin evening dress with her long black hair pinned by two red clips and a small mole beneath her right eye, leaning gracefully across to adjust Nene's slightly tilted hair ornament with a quiet, affectionate smile.
data.story: 晚宴散场后的休息厅只留几支摇曳的暖色长烛。换上珍珠白礼服的宁宁捧着小花束朝你腼腆微笑，身旁穿着香槟黑金礼裙的夏目则自然倾身替她扶正歪掉的发饰——「发饰都歪了还笑得这么开心……行了，现在拍照正好。」
